svg.title: Who connects the passing game?
svg.desc: First half, 10–40 minutes · completed passes only Source: StatsBomb Open Data. Dots = mean completed-pass origin; number tags are moved for legibility. Nodes require ≥3 origins. Arrows show ≥3 passes in that direction; width encodes count. Mean ball-action locations do not establish a fixed formation.
